messages:
lucy: hitting a regression in tokenizer edge-case for eu-west1 since 08:12 UTC. Some requests return truncated tokens causing downstream decode errors (5xx). Minimal fix in token_split.go: boundary check. Can we fast-path a hotfix?
omar: How invasive? Any model or infra changes?
lucy: purely code-level guard + tiny refactor. CI green locally. No model change.
eng-sre: We should canary first. Suggest 3% traffic for 8m, watch p50/p95 and 5xx. If drop is immediate, we can promote.
release-coordinator: Heads-up: if we pin, need a one-line release note and a rollback play. Approving expedited review if eng-sre monitors.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Build succeeded: registry/redwood/hotfix-token-279001. Canary rollout scheduled to eu-west1 token-service @ 3% (id t-279001-token). Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/tokenizer-hotfix.
lucy: starting canary now. posting obs links: grafana/d/tokenizer-ew1, traces/token-279001.
(deploy-bot reaction): :eyes: Canary started.
lucy: +3m update: 5xx down from 2.1% -> 0.02%, p99 steady, no CPU/mem increase.
eng-sre: looks good. no downstream errors. ops thresholds fine.
omar: ok to promote if eng-sre is comfortable. micro-rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/token-service token=registry/redwood/token:stable --namespace=eu-west1` and deploy-bot rollback `POST /deploys/t-279001/rollback`.
eng-sre: we'll monitor for 15m after promote. If any spike >0.5% 5xx, we rollback.
toni: tagging customer-success for release blurb: @cs-team please note small user-impact window.
lucy: promoting to 100% and pinning tag t-279001 now. Release note: "Hotfix: boundary check in tokenizer to prevent truncated tokens causing 5xx in eu-west1 (t-279001)."
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Service at 100% on t-279001. Health checks passing.
release-coordinator: Thanks. Filing release note and linking JIRA TK-998. Closing hotfix window.
eng-sre: continuing 15m watch. If anything, I'll trigger deploy-bot rollback.
